pages.title: Clonal Selector
pages.text: A rack of culture wells and a binding assay: each round, only the clones that hold on tightest are kept and grown.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the rounds and the stringency. Each round multiplies the affinity by (1 + s); it must reach the recipe's level. But each round also culls the clones: diversity falls as 100.e^(-n.s/3), and below 10% the line collapses to one clone.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Lasting Fracture Ward, Lasting Grey Goo Ward, Lasting Hollowing Ward, Lasting Metastasis Ward, Lasting Rewind Ward, Matured Antibody, Metastasis Ward.
